headline: Sensex Gains Over 500 Points Driven by Banking and FMCG Stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong buying interest in banking and FMCG sectors lifted benchmark indices.
Foreign Institutional Investor (FII) buying supported the domestic market rally.
Positive momentum pushed Nifty close to the 25,300 mark.
Consumer stocks provided additional support to main market indices.
whatHappening: Sensex surged over 500 points while Nifty50 closed near 25,291.
Tata Motors PV plunged 8.7% after JLR cut its FY27 margin outlook.
Max Healthcare featured among the top gainers during the trading session.
The Reserve Bank of India filed for a review of the Supreme Court's order on Yes Bank AT-1 bonds.
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty gained over 0.5%, driven by rallies in banking and FMCG stocks. FII inflows supported the rally, pushing Nifty towards the 25,300 mark. Max Healthcare was among the top gainers while Tata Motors fell significantly due to a reduced margin outlook for JLR.
